product: Private Car Package Policy (fictional, for demonstration)
note: All rates and limits are illustrative, modelled on common Indian motor insurance practice. Not any insurer's real product.

rules.name: Vehicle age
rules.description: Car age in years at policy start, from the registration date.

rules.name: Engine capacity band
rules.description: Places the car in an engine-size band used by third-party premium and deductible rules.

rules.name: Insured declared value (IDV)
rules.description: IDV = ex-showroom price reduced by an age-based percentage.

rules.name: Own-damage base rate
rules.description: Own-damage premium rate as a share of IDV, by car age.

rules.name: No Claim Bonus
rules.description: Discount on own-damage premium for consecutive claim-free years.

rules.name: Own-damage premium
rules.description: OD premium = IDV x OD rate x (1 - NCB).

rules.name: Third-party premium
rules.description: Fixed annual third-party premium by engine band.

rules.name: Roadside assistance add-on
rules.description: Existing optional add-on with a flat annual price.

rules.name: Net premium
rules.description: Net premium = OD premium + TP premium + all add-on premiums.

rules.name: GST
rules.description: Total premium = net premium plus 18% GST, rounded to the rupee.

rules.name: Maximum car age for comprehensive cover
rules.description: Comprehensive cover is not offered for cars older than 15 years.

rules.name: Annual invoice
rules.description: One invoice at policy start for the total premium.

rules.name: Mid-term endorsement invoice
rules.description: Bills premium changes made during the year, pro-rata for remaining months.

rules.name: Refund on cancellation
rules.description: Refunds unused OD and TP premium pro-rata when a policy is cancelled.

rules.name: Depreciation on replaced parts
rules.description: Deducts wear-and-tear depreciation from the cost of replaced parts.

rules.name: Compulsory deductible
rules.description: Amount the customer bears on every own-damage claim, by engine band.

rules.name: Total loss test
rules.description: A claim is a total loss when repair cost exceeds 75% of IDV.

rules.name: Claim payout
rules.description: Payout = parts cost - depreciation - deductible; total loss pays IDV - deductible.

rules.name: NCB reset after claim
rules.description: Any paid own-damage claim resets claim-free years to zero.

rules.name: Renewal re-rating
rules.description: At renewal the car is a year older; IDV and rates are recomputed.

rules.name: Policy schedule
rules.description: The schedule printed for the customer: IDV, covers, add-ons and premium breakdown.

rules.name: Policy wording
rules.description: Legal wording; every add-on needs its own clause.

rules.name: Claim settlement letter
rules.description: Explains to the customer what was paid and what was deducted.
